scope: Fix media repair errors (audio/video), resolve cloneMedia failure, fix video/audio attachment, and update video thumbnails

tasks.title: Resolve PowerPoint Repair Errors Triggered by addAudio and addVideo
tasks.description: Diagnose and fix the schema violations causing PowerPoint repair alerts when addAudio and addVideo are executed in showcase/media_advanced.js. Ensure dual relationship entries are created (audio/video element relationship plus standard media relationship), correct content types are registered in [Content_Types].xml (audio/mpeg, video/mp4, image/jpeg, image/png), and the <p:timing> condition sequences / sound action tags conform strictly to ECMA-376 DrawingML & PresentationML specifications without orphan rIds.

tasks.title: Fix Video Attachment & Embedding Pipeline in addVideo
tasks.description: Fix the issue where addVideo renders only an empty placeholder without attaching the playable video binary. Ingest video files/buffers into ppt/media/, allocate both the video relationship (http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/video) and the media reference (http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2007/relationships/media), bind them inside <p:pic>/<p:nvPicPr>/<p:nvPr> via <a:videoFile> and <p14:media>, and ensure the underlying binary payload is persisted in the ZIP package.

tasks.title: Fix Audio Attachment & Playback Embedding in addAudio
tasks.description: Fix addAudio failing to attach playable audio. Ingest audio files/buffers into ppt/media/, create the audio relationship (http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/audio) and media relationship (http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/2007/relationships/media), construct a schema-compliant audio shape (<p:pic> with audio icon blip and sound tag <a:audioFile>), and generate proper slide timing nodes (<p:timing>) to trigger playback.

tasks.title: Fix Video Thumbnail / Poster Frame Updating in updateVideo
tasks.description: Fix updateVideo retaining the old thumbnail when updating a video or changing its poster image. Ensure new poster image assets are ingested into ppt/media/, assign or update the image relationship rId in ppt/slides/_rels/slideN.xml.rels, and point <p:blipFill><a:blip r:embed="rId..."/> inside the video's <p:pic> container to the updated poster relationship.

tasks.title: Fix Media Duplication & Asset Binding in cloneMedia
tasks.description: Fix cloneMedia failure when duplicating audio, video, or image elements. Ensure cloneMedia duplicates the target <p:pic> node, generates a unique shape ID/name, copies or creates the required relationship references in slideN.xml.rels (reusing the underlying binary asset in ppt/media/), updates position/dimension transforms (<a:xfrm>), and duplicates any corresponding animation/timing triggers in <p:timing> for audio and video elements.

tasks.title: Verify showcase/media_advanced.js & Comprehensive Test Suite
tasks.description: Execute each media function individually and chained in showcase/media_advanced.js. Ensure the resulting presentation opens in Microsoft PowerPoint without triggering repair errors, videos and audio play back correctly, thumbnails update, and cloning works as expected. Add regression tests covering addAudio, addVideo, updateVideo, and cloneMedia.
